text_block_list.text:
As Симболи Рудольф completely immerses
herself in
her training, Нарита Брайан
arrives to inform her
about a problem on
the student council.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The general manager, not wanting to be
a burden
to the president she respects,
has asked to resign.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After some thought, Симболи Рудольф asks
the
general manager to come and watch
her run in
the Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
